source: Text supplied by Joshua on 2026-10-22. User-supplied romaji preserved. English is a provisional meaning translation; the phrase 'Boku ga sa maeru' is ambiguous and needs original-script review. No Japanese characters or timings invented.

rows.romaji: Futo shita kotoba ga mune wo kogasu
rows.en: A passing word sets my heart burning

rows.romaji: Boku ga sa maeru riyuu wa sa nakute
rows.en: I have no reason to dance [source wording uncertain]

rows.romaji: Tsubomi no setsuna ni memai ga shite
rows.en: In the fleeting moment of a bud, I grow dizzy

rows.romaji: Jitto jitto tojikomoru
rows.en: Staying still, still, shut away

rows.romaji: Onegai kaze ga fuitara
rows.en: Please, when the wind blows

rows.romaji: Mitsukete ne
rows.en: Find me

rows.romaji: Kimi to hira hira hira hira mada kowai kedo
rows.en: Fluttering, fluttering with you, though I'm still afraid

rows.romaji: Sabishikunai kurai harewataru mebuki deshita
rows.en: New shoots emerged beneath a sky so clear I wasn't lonely

rows.romaji: Kimi ga utau utau utau kara tsurarete matta
rows.en: You sing and sing and sing, and I am drawn into dancing

rows.romaji: Itsuka mata deaeru made waratte ite
rows.en: Keep smiling until we can meet again someday

rows.romaji: Omoeba kisetsu ga aseraseteta
rows.en: Looking back, the seasons were making me rush

rows.romaji: Boku ga sa maeru hazu nante nakute
rows.en: There was no way I could dance [source wording uncertain]

rows.romaji: Kimi no sa ryoute no nukumori dake ga
rows.en: Only the warmth of your two hands

rows.romaji: Naite inai kara kara karappo na kokoro dake
rows.en: I'm not crying; just this empty, empty heart

rows.romaji: Sore mo hana hiraku asatsuyu ga hoho wo nurasu
rows.en: Even that blossoms, as morning dew wets my cheeks

rows.romaji: Kimi ga yasashiku warau kara tsurarete matta
rows.en: Your gentle smile draws me into dancing

rows.romaji: Ryuuhyou no tsubomi wa tokasarete dakishimerareru
rows.en: The bud of drifting ice is melted and held close

rows.romaji: Ashita mo matteru kara
rows.en: I'll be waiting tomorrow too

rows.romaji: Datte bokura wa tooku temo hitotsu dakara
rows.en: Because even far apart, we are one
